name: cRZDate::cRZDate() (today, local)
notes: Hooked. ORIGINAL-BUG reproduced: localtime reads 64 bits from a 32-bit stack slot (upper half = saved frame pointer), the conversion fails and the date is Julian day 0; the test asserts 0 on both sides. The game's localtime wrapper (0x82fb8c) is redirected to our CRT in the test because the harness traps GetTimeZoneInformation. Mutant killed: correct high half (real date).
